map_nested_structure: apply a function to every leaf value in a nested list, tuple, or dict structure
flatten_nested_structure: recursively flatten a nested list, tuple, or dict into a flat sequence of leaf values
zip_nested_structures: zip multiple nested structures together, pairing corresponding leaf values into lists
map_many_nested_structures: apply a function to corresponding leaf values from multiple nested structures simultaneously
review_nest_module: review the nest module functions for recursive mapping, flattening, and zipping of nested data
